insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This field allows for multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment, providing more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking. Developers should review their existing code and update it to take advantage of this new feature. The GraphQL Admin API should be used to access this functionality.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving the overall customer experience. This change will also help merchants to better manage their fulfillment operations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking, which is essential for merchants to manage their fulfillment operations efficiently. It also improves the customer experience by providing more detailed tracking information.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL enhancements dominate the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as new flags, HTTP/2 support, and enhanced security features. The skeleton package also saw updates, recommending the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Enhancements
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing shopify_campaign_insights schema.

actions.text: Review and update Hydrogen projects to utilize the latest packages and features
